author: human
request:
Bug report: opening /owners?page=0 — or any page value below 1 — renders the
error page instead of the owner list. Expected behavior: the owner listing
treats any page value below 1 as the first page and responds with the normal
listing (HTTP 200). Find the cause, fix it, and cover the fix with a test.

author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing shows the first page for a page numbered below 1
summary: A request for the owner listing with a page numbered 0 or below currently renders the error page. The listing must treat any page below 1 as the first page and respond with the normal listing, exactly as a request for page 1 does.
acceptance_criteria: Given GET /owners?page=0, when the owner listing is requested, then the response is HTTP 200 with the owner listing, not the error page.

Given a page numbered below 1 (0 or any negative number), when the owner listing is requested, then the response matches a request for page 1: the first page of owners, with page 1 marked as the current page.
Given a last-name search matching several owners and a page numbered below 1, when the search runs, then the first page of that search's matches is listed.
Given a last-name search matching exactly one owner and a page numbered below 1, when the search runs, then that owner's record opens directly, as it does for page 1.
The fix is covered by a test that reproduces the error-page response for a page below 1 before the fix and passes after it.
non_goals: An owner-listing page beyond the last page: not named in the request; left open in the PRD Open Questions.
A non-numeric page value: not named in the request; left open in the PRD Open Questions.
The veterinarian directory's handling of a page below 1: not named in the request; left open in the PRD Open Questions, though it appears to share the same cause.
Changing the page size, the pagination controls, or the error page's content (REQ-SYS-002).
notes: Grounded in intake line 1 (request quoted verbatim; no decisions recorded). No contradiction with any recorded requirement or Non-Goals row; no Non-Goals row changed, so no scope_overrides. PRD edits: REQ-OWN-005 narrative sentence and anchor in Owner records, one Done-when bullet, edge cases 4 and 5, and one Open Question on the other out-of-range page cases. Observed cause: the one-based page number becomes a zero-based index with no lower bound, and the negative index is rejected, so the failure reaches the error page. Where the fix lives is the design expert's call; docs/architecture-principles.md (Web controller row) classes request-parameter range normalization as binding. The two test names are data-driven: the first covers page 0 and a negative page (edge case 4); the second covers a last-name search with a page below 1 (edge case 5). No prd-autofix records to audit.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Covered by the Web controller row of docs/architecture-principles.md § Pattern Catalog (In force): normalizing a request parameter to its permitted range is binding, not a business rule, so the fix belongs in OwnerController's owner-listing handler (docs/system-design.md § Contracts, OwnerController row, which now also cites REQ-OWN-005). No new type, module, pattern, or ADR. The cause is confirmed by grep/read (IDE oracle not connected; weaker basis): OwnerController.processFindForm binds `page` as an int with default 1 and passes it unclamped to findPaginatedForOwnersLastName, where PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) throws IllegalArgumentException for a negative index. The same raw value also feeds addPaginationModel's currentPage. Fix shape: normalize `page` to a minimum of 1 once, at the top of processFindForm, before either use. The search, the single-match redirect, and the pagination model then all see the normalized page exactly as a page=1 request would.
integration_points: Framework transport: MockMvc under the existing @WebMvcTest(OwnerController.class) is the sanctioned double (CLAUDE.md Testing Strategy; docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy). It drives real request-parameter binding, which this slice needs.

Repository boundary (OwnerRepository): reuse the existing @MockitoBean OwnerRepository fixture in OwnerControllerTests. This is a framework stub, a conscious exception under docs/testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy. A hand-written double would have to implement the whole Spring Data JpaRepository surface, and the real H2-backed repository belongs to the integration suite, not this controller test class. New stubs stay limited to findByLastNameStartingWith; the tests assert the Pageable reaching it carries page index 0.

Binding: no new entry point. GET /owners keeps binding `page` as a request-scoped int; the only change is range normalization of that int inside the handler (docs/security-principles.md § Trust Boundaries, external-input row: validate range before use). The existing Owner search-form binding and its id/*.id disallow list are unchanged.

patterns.description: processFindForm: the single owner-listing entry point. Normalize here so findPaginatedForOwnersLastName and addPaginationModel both receive the normalized page
existing page=1 listing and search tests. The new data-driven tests mirror them with page 0 and a negative page

risks.risk: Clamping only inside findPaginatedForOwnersLastName would fix the error page but leave currentPage at 0 or a negative value, breaking the 'page 1 marked as current' criterion
risks.mitigation: Normalize once at the handler entry, before both uses; assert the currentPage model attribute equals 1 (docs/architecture-principles.md § Pattern Catalog, Web controller row)

risks.risk: Rejecting the value (for example a @Min constraint or a 400 response) would satisfy the trust-boundary row's wording but contradict REQ-OWN-005, which makes a page below 1 part of the contract
risks.mitigation: Normalize, do not reject: the contract permits a page below 1 and maps it to page 1, so nothing outside the contract remains to reject (docs/security-principles.md § Trust Boundaries; Web controller row)

risks.risk: A cross-cutting fix (a @ControllerAdvice, a custom argument resolver, or a shared paging helper) would also change the veterinarian directory, which the prd-entry lists as a non-goal
risks.mitigation: Keep the normalization local to OwnerController; leave VetController untouched (docs/architecture-principles.md § Design Principles 5, Minimal surface)

notes: Autofix audit: no design-doc-autofix records in the log; skipped. Design write: REQ-OWN-005 added to the OwnerController Implements cell in docs/system-design.md § Contracts, for the contracts-sync gate. No ADR: the choice has no trade-off that constrains later slices and is already stated by the Web controller row. Observation for the PRD Open Question: VetController.showVetList has the same unclamped PageRequest.of(page - 1, ...) shape, so it will need the same local normalization if that question is ever answered in scope.

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner-listing page below 1 to the first page

blast_radius.note: One production file, one handler: a single Math.max clamp at the top of OwnerController.processFindForm feeding both existing uses of page; no sensitive paths, no security-surface hits, and the docs edits are one PRD paragraph plus bullets and one Implements-cell tag.

semantic_surprise.note: Read the hunks against the full handler: currentPage replaces page at both call sites (the PageRequest.of(page - 1) arithmetic and the currentPage model attribute), so no raw page value leaks through; page 1 and above behave exactly as before, and the only behavior change is below-1 input going from an exception (or, for Integer.MIN_VALUE, a wraparound to an empty not-found result) to the first page, which is the stated contract.

test_adequacy.note: Three parameterized MockMvc tests over 0, -1 and Integer.MIN_VALUE stub the repository only for a Pageable with no previous page and assert currentPage == 1 plus the exact listing or the single-match redirect; the Frank prefix avoids the Franklin setup stub, so an unclamped or half-clamped implementation would fail (exception, null page, or wrong currentPage) rather than pass tautologically.

reviewer_hedging.note: All three dispatched reviewers (code-quality, test, doc) approved first round with no findings; security-reviewer was scoped out by the review plan with a stated reason, which is expected silence; the one recommendation is cosmetic comment trimming, and spot-checked citations (OwnerController.java:97-98, prd.md:70, system-design.md:95) resolve to the lines named.

scope_deviation.note: Zero design revisions, consultations, and build retries; the diff matches the prd-entry and design-block exactly, keeps the fix local to OwnerController, and leaves VetController's identical unclamped paging (plus beyond-last and non-numeric pages) as recorded non-goals in the PRD Open Questions.

rationale: A contained, correct-by-reading clamp: the normalized page reaches both the page arithmetic and the model, tests would fail against a broken fix, and review was clean. A glance suffices.
